items.title: Composition of internal Hom complexes as a map from the total tensor product
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs the canonical composition map from the total tensor product of two internal Hom complexes into the internal Hom of the outer two complexes, and the proof is a 54-line argument that gives both the categorical origin of the map and a direct construction. The direct construction expands an element of the left hand side into components indexed by bidegrees and writes each component as a finite sum of tensor products of families of maps, then defines the image componentwise by composing the two families and summing over the intermediate index, and finally checks that the sum is finite and that the result is compatible with the differentials. The finiteness of the sum over the middle index and the sign comparison are the two places where the work lies, and both are displayed.
